item.title: nixos/fprintd: Add separate enablePam option to fprintd service
item.description:
Because fprintd does not have a mechanism to ensure user attention, using it to authenticate to programs such as sudo or su is not secure. This was assigned CVE-2024-37408. A comment was added to the PAM fprintAuth option to make this clear.

This commit also adds the option services.fprintd.enablePam, which is now used to control the default use of the fprintd PAM authorization. Enabling this option emits an evaluation-time warning so users are aware of this issue. This setting defaults to services.fprintd.enable for now, but could default to false in future releases.

See #442117 for more details, discussion can continue there for better mitigation. Perhaps in the future enablePam could accept an option such as "attention", which would only enable it for PAM services that opt-in.
